title: 50 Reasons to Travel to Papua New Guinea
supports: monthly POM City Markets selling locally made craft at changing city venues
hidden_gem_rationale: A periodic artisan-led city market rather than a fixed mass-tour attraction, with venue and timing requiring current local checking.

supports: Mataniko cascade as one of Guadalcanal's inland waterfall treks
